preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] + [n for n in nodes_in_tree(root) if n is not None])
preconditions.description: Every node's value in the tree must be an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(node.val * mirror_node.val for node, mirror_node in mirror_pairs(root)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The function returns the sum of the product of each node and its mirror image, computed modulo 10^9 + 7, where mirror_pairs(root) generates all unique (node, mirror_node) pairs in the tree.
